authorship.model_snapshot: current Codex task model; exact deployment id not exposed to task

mechanics.novelty_claim: Observation is the actuator: visibility changes whether an object advances, rather than merely changing what the player knows. Opposite visibility policies, movable occluders, and behavior-changing track points are composed into synchronization problems.
closest_prior_art: ARC public and Cellens fog/occlusion environments
Weeping Angel style observation trope, reduced to a turn-based causal system

progression.new_demand: A shy piece moves only while occluded.
A visually different bold piece moves only while observed.
Synchronize one shy and one bold loop.
Use geometry to occlude one of two similar pieces selectively.
Rotate a shutter to change visibility without moving the observer.
A piece changes temperament after crossing a visible track point.
Coordinate three loops through two independently controlled veils.
Compose opposite temperaments, several occluders, and a mid-route rule change.

visual_identity.silhouette_grammar: Crescents, radial bursts, hollow sockets, a diamond observer, and ribbon-like occluders.
visual_identity.spatial_grammar: Sparse dotted loops embedded in a continuous dark field rather than a filled tile maze.
visual_identity.motion_grammar: World pieces move only on explicit pulses; observer and shutters alter causal visibility between pulses.
visual_identity.hud_grammar: Two short vertical budget rails and a transient pulse glint, with no text or digits.
